channel.title: Greenlight: Healing SCP with potential for GK scenario
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Greenlight: Healing SCP with potential for GK scenario" - Scp I drafted up before reading about the Greenlight process

item.title: Re: Greenlight: Healing SCP with potential for GK scenario
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open for crit
– hide block

The range of its search doubles every 4 hours that it doesn't have someone to heal and it gets more and more agitated that it can't find someone to heal.

How does this 'searching' work? Like is it physically going to places? Does it just, radar sweep for people? Why does the range increase exponentially like this?

After 24 hours it will attempt to heal terminal medical conditions, resulting in accidental euthanasia.

how does this result in accidental euthanasia? This feels like you're going for like 'too much healing is bad' or something but it's not exactly clear how it gets here since the implication is the mannequin is good at healing? This applies to the 'healed of humanity' angle too like…there's not really any indication the mannequin heals badly until it gets too big?

I think my big issue with this is that…it just, doesn't feel very interesting to me? There's a lot of elements that are here but don't really go anywhere, or just feel added in to add more threat to this (e.g., the 'gk world ending scenario' angle, the 'aggression' of the SCP, the exponentially increasing range), and it feels like focussing on this being a SCP that can heal as the only thing it does would be more effective, particularly since the core of the story you want to tell is 'foundation tries to stop it healing and it doesn't'.

Part of the problem with this though is it feels…very surface level? You don't really do anything with this beyond having it heal someone, and I'm just kinda…looking for more emotional impact here? Like, some kind of exploration of its existence that makes me feel sorry for it not helping, or like, really ties the 'overhealing' kinda stuff in so it feels like an important part of the narrative or something, y'know?

item.title: Anomalous healing clockwork mannequin with potential for GK world ending scenario
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: 250 year old clockwork Mannequin SCP with anomalous healing properties that searches for injured humans within a large, exponentially increasing range and attempts to heal them through anomalous means. The range of its search doubles every 4 hours that it doesn't have someone to heal and it gets more and more agitated that it can't find someone to heal. After 24 hours it will attempt to heal terminal medical conditions, resulting in accidental euthanasia. Theorised that if the range encompasses the entire globe, the earth itself may be 'healed' of humanity.

Central Narrative: SCP is picked up through word of mouth rumour and is reported to the coucil who send an mtf team after it. MTF epsilon 6 apprehend the SCP in sweeden, where the locals attempt to stop the task force from attacking it and try to persuade them it just wants to help. MTF team retrieve the SCP which begins becoming aggressive as it cannot reach the subject it wanted to heal. Once it's taken back to a foundation site, it's placed under low level containment during testing of properties as it didn't break initial mtf containment. After a task force operation results in an operator falling into a critical condition, the SCP breaks containment, incapacitating but not wounding security team members that attempt to stop it, and goes to protect the fatally wounded mtf operator until the doctors approach calmly and it let's them help. After this its moved to special containment and special procedures are put in place.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: large initial range of detection with exponentially increasing range as time passes and the SCP goes without healing someone. To help contain it, injured class D personnel are given to the entity heal to stop it from causing a potential humanity extinction event.

Additional Notes: the severity of the injury also increases the aggression level of the SCP
